constraints.full_renderer_suite: not rerun by this checker; user supplied full renderer 866/866 as precondition

java.finding: SvgGraphics initializes gradientId from 'g' plus getSeed(seed); createSvgGradient keys the map by color1, color2, and policy, appends gradients.size() only on first key insertion, and emits policy-specific endpoints.
applyFillColor turns HColorGradient backgrounds into SvgGraphics.createSvgGradient calls before setting fill='url(#id)'.
Ellipse drawing delegates fill handling to DriverRectangleSvg.applyFillColor, so Description use-case ovals consume the same gradient registry as rectangles.
EntityImageDescription resolves the entity Fashion/background once, then asSmall.drawU paints the actor/use-case symbol using that background.

rust.finding: GradientKey is exactly resolved color1, resolved color2, and policy. GradientRegistry assigns ids by seed prefix plus insertion index and deduplicates equal keys.

DescriptionPaint preserves gradient type until paint ordering. description_gradient_registry walks the same entity order used by render, registers only actor/use-case gradients, and supplies registry ids to fill attributes.
The parser/preprocessor injects __svgIdSeed from the Java-compatible StringUtils.seed path; usecase.rs consumes that prefix before falling back to hashing meta.source.
Sequence now calls the shared endpoint and registry renderer while retaining its existing skinparam traversal for registration.

fixture_logic.finding: No production-code branch was keyed to the Cerulean fixture, golden paths, known gradient ids, or expected SVG dimensions. Hits were tests, generic labels, comments, or unrelated existing code.

unexplained_constants.finding: New mechanism constants are SVG endpoint strings taken directly from SvgGraphics#createSvgGradient policy mapping. No parity-affecting high-precision numeric constants were added for this mechanism.

seed_ownership.finding: Held-outs with plain source-hash seeds produced Java/Rust matching ids; source audit confirms parser-carried __svgIdSeed is preferred when present and the fallback hashes meta.source.

first_paint_order.finding: The package-member held-out forced a top-level actor to appear earlier in source than package members. Java and Rust both assigned g...0 to the package member use-case gradient and g...1 to the actor gradient.

dedup_key.finding: The named-color held-out reused Gold/LightBlue across actor and use-case backgrounds. Java and Rust both emitted one gradient definition and three url fills; the inline solid actor did not consume the gradient id.

policy_orientation.finding: Held-outs covered '/', '-', and '|' policies. Java and Rust endpoint attributes matched for each exercised policy.

flat_fill_behavior.finding: The flat/transparent control emitted zero gradients in both Java and Rust, with transparent actor fill='none' and flat use-case fill='#ABCDEF'.

shared_sequence_behavior.finding: The Sequence control emitted the same two gradient ids, endpoints, stops, and url fill counts in Java and Rust using the shared registry renderer.

residue: Description held-outs are not whole-SVG byte matches because existing no-oracle layout and metadata still differ from Java. This review accepts only the gradient registry mechanism: definition identity/order/endpoints/stops, fill references, deduplication, and flat-fill behavior.
No comparator or Cargo-based perturbation test was run because the user explicitly forbade Cargo/rustc in this checker task and no frozen diff_one binary existed in this worktree.
rationale: The implementation matches Java's SvgGraphics gradient ownership model for the reviewed mechanism: source-seeded ids are assigned in first use order, the key is resolved color1/color2/policy, endpoint orientation matches Java, equal keys deduplicate across actor and use-case shapes, flat and transparent colors do not allocate hidden gradient definitions, and the shared Sequence registry rendering remains compatible on the held-out control. No fixture-shaped logic or unexplained mechanism constants were found.
